comment: Presentation fold for the monthly legacy-vs-ERP tie-out. The legacy Trial Balance print (i) renames a few account codes and (ii) prints one DEBTOR control row where the ERP carries one DEBTOR child per customer. Joining without this fold produces pages of false differences. aliases: legacy printed code -> ERP code. foldIntoParent: ERP accounts whose parent_code is listed here are summed into the parent before comparing.
